spec.title: Sum of Purchase Day of Week

spec.rawSql: select case when d.day_of_week in (6, 7) then 'Weekend' else 'Weekday' end as day_type, count(distinct f.order_id) as order_count from public.fact_order_items f join public.dim_status s on f.order_id = s.order_id join public.dim_date d on s.purchase_date_key = d.date_key group by 1;

select initcap(replace(coalesce(p.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown'), '_', ' ')) as category from public.fact_order_items f join public.dim_products p on f.product_id = p.product_id group by 1 order by count(f.product_id) desc limit 1;
select initcap(customer_city) as customer_city from public.dim_customers group by customer_city order by count(customer_unique_id) desc limit 1;

select date_trunc('month', d.date_actual) as time, sum(f.price) as revenue from public.fact_order_items f join public.dim_status s on f.order_id = s.order_id join public.dim_date d on s.purchase_date_key = d.date_key group by 1 order by time;

select coalesce(p.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown') as category, count(distinct f.order_id) as orders from public.fact_order_items f join public.dim_products p on f.product_id = p.product_id group by 1 order by orders desc limit 5;

select c.customer_state as state, count(distinct f.order_id) as total_orders, count(distinct c.customer_unique_id) as total_customers, sum(f.price) as total_revenue from public.fact_order_items f join public.dim_customers c on f.customer_id = c.customer_id group by c.customer_state order by total_revenue desc;
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM raw.orders;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment_value), 0) as value FROM raw.payments;

spec.title: 🔴 LIVE – Avg Review Score
spec.description: Điểm đánh giá trung bình realtime

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score)::numeric, 2) as value FROM raw.reviews;
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM raw.items;

spec.title: 🔴 LIVE – Orders/sec (Last 5 min)
spec.description: Tốc độ orders vào theo giây (5 phút gần nhất)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('second', inserted_at::timestamp) AS time, 
    COUNT(*) AS "Orders/sec" 
FROM raw.orders 
WHERE inserted_at::timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 1;
